zh-CN.title:
常用操作，
就在指间。
zh-CN.subtitle:
呼出键盘面板，按下对应键位，
打开应用、文件或网址。
zh-CN.caption: 键盘启动器：按对应键位或点击图标，打开绑定的应用、文件、文件夹或网址。

zh-CN.title:
每一个键位，
都有你的安排。
zh-CN.subtitle:
为应用、网址、脚本和快捷键
安排顺手的位置。
zh-CN.caption: 绑定编辑器：为键位设置应用、文件、网址、脚本或快捷键，并自定义名称和图标。

zh-CN.title:
熟悉的按键，
顺手的节奏。
zh-CN.subtitle:
自定义组合快捷键，
或双击修饰键呼出面板。
zh-CN.caption: 快捷键设置：自定义组合键或双击修饰键，显示与隐藏启动面板。

zh-CN.title:
明暗之间，
自在切换。
zh-CN.subtitle:
浅色、深色或跟随系统。
中文与英文，即刻切换。
zh-CN.caption: 常规设置：切换简体中文或英文界面，选择浅色、深色或跟随系统主题。

zh-CN.title:
你的习惯，
留在你的电脑。
zh-CN.subtitle:
键位配置保存在本机，
每次更改保留上一版本。
zh-CN.caption: 系统设置：管理快捷键冲突，并打开本机配置文件所在文件夹。

en-US.title:
Your everyday.
One key away.
en-US.subtitle:
Open the keyboard panel. Press a key.
Launch your apps, files and websites.
en-US.caption: Keyboard launcher: press a mapped key or click an icon to open an app, file, folder or website.

en-US.title:
A place for
every action.
en-US.subtitle:
Map apps, websites, scripts and shortcuts
to keys that make sense to you.
en-US.caption: Binding editor: assign apps, files, websites, scripts or shortcuts to a key, with a custom name and icon.

en-US.title:
Your keys.
Your rhythm.
en-US.subtitle:
Choose a keyboard shortcut,
or double-tap a modifier key.
en-US.caption: Shortcut settings: choose a key combination or double-tap modifier to show and hide the launcher.

en-US.title:
Light or dark.
Always yours.
en-US.subtitle:
Choose a theme or follow your system.
Switch between English and Chinese.
en-US.caption: General settings: switch between English and Simplified Chinese, and choose light, dark or system appearance.

en-US.title:
Your workflow.
On your computer.
en-US.subtitle:
Bindings stay on your device.
The previous configuration is kept after changes.
en-US.caption: System settings: manage shortcut conflicts and open the folder containing your local configuration.
